penalties.details: The Company has received an Order from the Office of the Assessment Unit, Income Tax Department raising a demand of Rs. 19,85,543,/- The issue pertains to under-reported income which is in consequence of misreporting under section 274 read with section 270A of the Income-tax Act,1961, pertaining to the assessment year 2023-24.
penalties.impact: Considering the merits of the case, the Company intends to file appeal before the Appellate Authority within time limit prescribed under the Law. The Company is confident of a favorable outcome thereof and does not expect the said Order to have any material financial impact on the Company.

penalties.impact: Considering the merits of the case, Aeroflex Industries Limited, the subsidiary company intends to file appeal before the Appellate Authority within time-limit prescribed under the Law and is hopeful of a favorable outcome thereof and does not expect the said Order to have any material financial impact on it.

operating_notes.text: M.R. Organisation had consolidated turnover of ₹78.25 Cr in FY25, ₹68.37 Cr in FY24 and ₹71.62 Cr in FY23.
MRO operates across 29 states via 59 locations and 5 warehouses, exports to 75 countries and has presence in India, UK, USA, Belgium and Portugal.
Agreed to sell 68% stake in M.R. Organisation Limited to Ingersoll-Rand Industrial U.S., Inc for ₹227.42 Cr.
Received ₹222.87 Cr for the 68% MRO stake; balance consideration subject to customary post-closing conditions under the SPSA.
Aeroflex Industries approved ₹202 Cr capex for capacity enhancements across SS Hose & Braiding and Liquid Cooling SFN Skid Assemblies divisions.
Stilonn Valves had a turnover of ₹16.22 Cr in FY25-26, ₹8.19 Cr in FY24-25, and ₹6.10 Cr in FY23-24.
Stilonn Valves and Controls Private Limited became a subsidiary of Aeroflex Neu Limited holding 51.01% stake.
Aeroflex Industries approved in-principle the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary Hyd-Air Engineering Private Limited.
Aeroflex Neu approved acquiring 55% stake in Aerolex Cables Private Limited for ₹31 crores.

timeline.summary: On 21 April 2026 Aeroflex acquired a further 4% of subsidiary M.R. Organisation for ₹5.58 Cr, taking its stake to 68% in the third tranche of its July 2024 share purchase agreement.
On 24 April 2026, subsidiary M.R. Organisation acquired the remaining 49% stake in Madhura Compressors Private Limited, making it a wholly owned subsidiary.
On 29 April 2026, Aeroflex approved the sale of its 68% stake in M.R. Organisation Limited to Ingersoll-Rand for ₹227.42 Cr.

On 30 April 2026 Aeroflex completed the sale of its entire 68% stake in M.R. Organisation Limited to Ingersoll-Rand Industrial US, Inc, receiving ₹222.87 Cr with the balance subject to post-closing conditions; MRO ceased to be a subsidiary.
Harikant Turgalia, Whole Time Director & CFO, declared Aeroflex Enterprises holds 79,181,833 equity shares of Aeroflex Industries as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances.
On April 3, 2026, promoter A Flex Invest Private Limited declared zero share encumbrance on its 75,00,000 equity shares in Aeroflex Enterprises for FY26.
Board of Directors recommended final dividend of ₹0.40 per equity share (20%) for FY2025-26, subject to AGM approval.
Aeroflex Neu completed the acquisition of a 51.01% equity stake in Stilonn Valves and Controls Private Limited.
Aeroflex Industries approved the amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary Hyd-Air Engineering with effect from April 1, 2026.
Aeroflex Neu approved the acquisition of a 55% stake in Aerolex Cables Private Limited for ₹31 crore.
